tests.name: Equal values stay in order
tests.expr: (insertion_sort(a), [id(x) for x in a] == [id(x) for x in order])

tests.name: 2 000 random values
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(79)
values = [random.randint(0, 10**6) for _ in range(2000)]

tests.name: 100 000 values, nearly sorted
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(790)
values = list(range(100000))
for _ in range(200):
    i = random.randrange(99999)
    values[i], values[i + 1] = values[i + 1], values[i]
tests.hint: On nearly sorted data, insertion sort should only do a little work per value.
